title: Protocol settings
summary: ASTM and HL7 settings, instrument presets and the delimited file template.

sections.title: ASTM
paragraphs: Link role is the side PACK-IE plays when both ends start sending at once: Computer yields to the instrument and sends after receiving; Instrument has priority. Characters per frame is 240 unless the instrument documents long frames (up to 64000); both ends must agree. A destination tries ENQ attempts times before the delivery policy retries. A source's Sample id path says where the order record carries the id Messages search by: O.3, or O.4.3 for component 3 of field 4. For AU instruments see AU settings help.

sections.title: HL7 v2
paragraphs: Acknowledgement mode Original sends one acknowledgement after the message is stored and checked. Enhanced adds a commit acknowledgement and, when asked, an application acknowledgement. For a destination it is what the receiver is expected to send; None expects none. A source cannot use None.

The HL7 version is that of the messages PACK-IE writes. Clear Carriage return after the end block for senders that omit it. A destination lists the Accepted answer codes: an order message is answered by ORL or ORR, which must be listed. A source can reply to order messages with an order response; AA then means stored, not that the order was accepted.

sections.title: Presets
paragraphs: Instrument presets fill in these settings for known cases. The dialog lists each setting now and after; only changes are written, into fields you can edit. They are not hardware-qualified; test them.

sections.title: Delimited files
paragraphs: The column template (a JSON object) describes the file: the delimiter, whether there is a header row, and the columns, each with a name and a type (string, integer, decimal, date or datetime; a date needs a format such as yyyyMMdd). Decimals keep their text exactly. Columns named control_id, sample_id and patient_id fill those identifiers.
A destination's template also needs a file_name without folders, which may use {message_id}, {control_id}, {sample_id}, {date}, {time} and {seq}.
